title: AWS command state and transport resources are explicitly provisioned
description:
As a platform operator, I want the portable command service state and transport resources provisioned through reusable infrastructure, so that deployments are deterministic and workers never create cloud resources at runtime.

Feature: Managed command state and transport primitives
  Scenario: A consumer composes the AWS command service foundation
    Given a consumer-supplied resource prefix and environment
    When the reusable stack is synthesized
    Then it contains one retained encrypted DynamoDB table
    And it contains one encrypted command queue with a dead-letter queue
    And it contains an alarm for visible dead-letter messages
    And it contains no command runtime, API, dashboard, Celery, or client-specific behavior
